moved.sentence: Use Firebase App Indexing or `AppIndexingApi` for on-device search integration.

judged.note: android-use-app-indexing keeps Firebase App Indexing or AppIndexingApi for on-device search on Android, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Declare searchable content in `searchable.xml` and implement `SearchableInfo`.

judged.note: android-declare-searchable-content keeps searchable.xml and SearchableInfo on Android, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Support Google Assistant via structured content markup.

judged.note: android-support-assistant-markup keeps Google Assistant support via structured content markup, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Use Core Spotlight (`CSSearchableItem`, `CSSearchableItemAttributeSet`) to index content.

judged.note: apple-index-with-core-spotlight keeps Core Spotlight (CSSearchableItem, CSSearchableItemAttributeSet) for indexing on Apple platforms, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: On iOS 17+, conform entities to `IndexedEntity` for semantic indexing with natural language support.

judged.note: ios17-conform-to-indexedentity keeps the iOS 17+ condition, IndexedEntity conformance and the semantic/natural-language reason, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Support `NSUserActivity` donation for Handoff-eligible items to appear in Spotlight suggestions.

judged.note: apple-donate-nsuseractivity keeps NSUserActivity donation for Handoff-eligible items to reach Spotlight suggestions, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Index content that users would reasonably search for — documents, contacts, messages, settings

judged.note: index-what-users-search-for keeps indexing what users would reasonably search for, with its examples, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Keep the search index current — add items when created, remove when deleted

judged.note: keep-index-current keeps adding items on create and removing on delete, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Each indexed item MUST deep link back to the relevant content

judged.note: must-deep-link-indexed-items keeps the MUST that each indexed item deep link back to its content.

moved.sentence: Include rich metadata (thumbnails, descriptions, categories) for meaningful search results

judged.note: include-rich-metadata keeps thumbnails, descriptions and categories for meaningful results, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Use structured data (JSON-LD, Schema.org) for search engine discoverability.

judged.note: web-use-structured-data keeps JSON-LD/Schema.org structured data for search engine discoverability, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Implement OpenGraph and Twitter Card meta tags.

judged.note: web-implement-social-meta-tags keeps OpenGraph and Twitter Card meta tags on the web, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Support the Web App Manifest for PWA search integration.

judged.note: web-support-web-app-manifest keeps the Web App Manifest for PWA search integration, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Ensure server-side rendering or pre-rendering for crawlability.

judged.note: web-ensure-crawlability keeps server-side rendering or pre-rendering for crawlability, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Use the Windows Search indexer with `ISearchManager` and property handlers.

judged.note: windows-use-search-indexer keeps the Windows Search indexer with ISearchManager and property handlers, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Register file type associations and protocol handlers so content appears in Start menu search.

judged.note: windows-register-associations-and-protocols keeps file type associations and protocol handlers for Start menu search, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: For UWP/WinUI, use `SearchPane` or in-app search with system integration.

judged.note: windows-uwp-winui-search keeps the UWP/WinUI condition and SearchPane or system-integrated in-app search, at SHOULD.
